fixtureNote: Every figure here is the implementer's own and can never resolve for a real household or a real year. The boundaries, the premiums, the adjustments and the lookback offset are all deliberately unlike any published figure, so an implementation reading recalled boundaries or a recalled offset instead of the pack's own produces a different answer against it. Both boundary operators the shipped pack uses are exercised, and the three premium legs all carry non-zero, mutually distinct figures so a leg dropped from a surface or summed into a tax total changes a total by an amount unique to it.

lookbackOffsetYears.quotedOffsetBasis: This fixture declares a three-year lookback offset, which no published rule states, so an engine holding a two-year offset as a module constant produces a different required year against it.

single.quotedBasis: This fixture maps every status it enumerates to one bracket set so the boundary arithmetic is the only thing under test.

married-filing-jointly.quotedBasis: This fixture maps every status it enumerates to one bracket set so the boundary arithmetic is the only thing under test.
